summary: Ephemeral access denied for LLM-debug proxy due to environment tag normalization mismatch
description:
Issue summary: Ephemeral service-account->STS delegation for the LLM debug proxy is failing when requests come from the new sandbox tagging pipeline. Impact: On-call engineers cannot spin up ephemeral LLM-debug sessions for customer-facing investigations or reproduce production errors in the staging bridge. This blocks a P1 customer investigation and slows root-cause work on a separate latency incident.

Environment: Production identity broker and ephemeral-impersonation flow that exchanges GCP WIF tokens for AWS STS assume-role with session tags. This started after the org tagging normalizer rolled out last night.

Observed behavior: 'sts:AssumeRole' calls return AccessDenied with tag mismatch errors and GCP impersonation calls return 'Permission denied: serviceAccountTokenCreator' when the token contains an 'env' attribute set by the normalizer. Expected behavior: Ephemeral sessions should be allowed when the env tag matches our allowed values and the identity-broker translates tags as before.

Initial logs/artifacts: See sample AWS error: 'An error occurred (AccessDenied) when calling the AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity operation: Not authorized to perform sts:AssumeRole with session tags: env=staging-llm-debug'. GCP audit entry: 'iam.serviceAccounts.signJwt denied: Constraint Violation — attribute namespace removed by org-policy-normalizer'.

Impact scope: Any engineer using the LLM-debug proxy in affected regions; affected customers currently under investigation: internal POC and one enterprise customer reproducing a model regression.

Request: Restore ephemeral impersonation flow with a safe, timebound change and follow up with a policy fix and unit tests for the tag normalizer.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Request ephemeral LLM debug session via /internal/debug-proxy UI
2) Identity broker exchanges user GCP token for ephemeral SA impersonation (gcloud auth print-identity-token -> /impersonate endpoint)
3) Broker calls AWS STS AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity with session tags derived from incoming token (env=staging-llm-debug, namespace=analytics)
4) STS returns AccessDenied with session tag mismatch; broker logs 'session tag rejected' and returns 403 to UI

2026-03-10 10:03 - Mei Chen (Cloud SRE): Confirmed GCP audit shows 'attribute namespace missing' for tokens issued after 2026-03-10T00:30Z. Reverting the normalizer rollback flag in staging for testing.

investigation_notes: Identity-broker trace: incoming token payload previously contained attributes 'env' and 'namespace'. After normalizer rollout, 'namespace' is removed for tokens originating from project:analytics-sandbox.
AWS AssumeRole condition requires: 'StringEquals': {'aws:RequestTag/namespace': 'analytics'} for the ephemeral role. When namespace missing, sts rejects request even if env tag is allowed.

Root cause chain: org-tag-normalizer policy introduced to remove PII-like attributes inadvertently strips 'namespace' for sandbox projects. This started after config commit: github.com/redwood-inference/infra-config/commit/8f3b1c2 which changed tag whitelist rules.
Reproducible: Re-running broker exchange with a token that lacks 'namespace' yields identical AccessDenied. Adding a synthetic 'namespace' tag to the STS request succeeds for test role (dev-only).
Risk assessment: synthetic-tag workaround is low-risk if scoped to ephemeral role and logged. Broader policy change must be vetted to avoid leakage of tenant identifiers.
resolution:
Temporary mitigation: identity-broker patched to inject a deterministic, non-sensitive 'namespace' tag for ephemeral debug sessions originating from approved internal projects. This patch is timebound and includes an audit log entry for every synthesized tag. Customer-facing impact resolved at 2026-03-11 03:15 UTC.

Follow-ups created: 1) Roll back or adjust org-tag-normalizer rule to preserve internal 'namespace' attribute for identity tokens (track INT-135431). 2) Add unit and integration tests to infra-config CI to prevent tag-whitelist regressions (track INT-135432). 3) Implement an observability alert when STS AssumeRole failures due to missing tags exceed threshold for any region.

Permanent fix plan: update org-policy-normalizer to maintain a minimal allowlist that explicitly preserves internal attributes used for auth decisions, land infra-config PR with tests and schedule a coordinated rollout with SRE/security.
